L01.drivers: slender narrow-shouldered build but profile torso is strongly curved: pronounced chest bulge and rounded upper back, narrow waist, arms hang forward with a visible elbow bend, knees slightly flexed and forward, thin calves
limb_cues: arms held forward with bent elbows
thin shanks with distinct knee bulge

structure.axial_section_shape: barrel-like thorax tapering sharply to narrow waist and small pelvis
structure.joint_integration: knobby, distinct elbows and knees; shoulders slightly forward
structure.segment_relations: long thin limbs, small trunk relative to limbs, normal hands/feet
structure.load_path: trunk carried slightly forward, weight through flexed knees onto forefoot-ish stance

non_structural_factors.notes: read hinges on curved torso profile and flexed stance; could be a thin, stooped human

L02.drivers: ordinary proportions, soft torso, slight belly and prominent buttocks in profile, wider hips

structure.axial_section_shape: soft oval trunk, slightly wide pelvis
structure.load_path: vertical through pelvis and straight legs to flat feet

L03.drivers: lean ordinary human build, normal proportions

L04.drivers: lean ordinary human build, normal proportions

L05.drivers: ordinary human, slightly soft with belly and prominent buttocks, wider hips

L06.drivers: ordinary human, somewhat broader shoulders and chest

L07.drivers: same pattern as L01: narrow shoulders, strongly bulging chest and rounded back in profile, narrow waist, forward-hanging bent arms, flexed knees, thin shanks
axial_cues: bulging thorax and upper-back hump in profile

structure.axial_section_shape: deep barrel thorax pinching to narrow waist/pelvis
structure.load_path: weight carried forward through flexed knees

non_structural_factors.notes: twin of L01; might be stooped thin human

L10.drivers: very wide trunk, huge club-like forearms and hands, short thick bowed legs with bent knees, oversized feet, trunk pitched forward in profile

structure.axial_section_shape: massive broad barrel trunk with little waist taper
structure.joint_integration: lumpy heavy joints, big knee and ankle masses
structure.segment_relations: short legs, long heavy arms, oversized hands and feet relative to trunk
structure.load_path: forward-leaning trunk onto wide pelvis, through flexed bowed legs to broad feet

non_structural_factors.notes: bulk alone would not explain short legs and giant hands/feet

L12.drivers: same as L10 but even broader/more muscular: huge trunk, giant forearms and fists, short bowed bent legs, very large feet, forward-pitched trunk

structure.segment_relations: short legs, heavy long arms, oversized hands/feet
structure.load_path: forward trunk through wide pelvis and flexed bowed legs to broad feet

distinguishing_features: L10/L12 are massive with short bowed legs, giant forearms and hands, oversized feet and a forward-pitched heavy trunk. L01/L07 are slender with a curved, deep-chested, narrow-waisted torso, forward-hanging bent arms and flexed knees. L01/L07 are only weakly separated from ordinary humans and could be stooped thin humans.
